title: Spinach and feta dip with crunchy veg

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Spinach, garlic, Greek yoghurt, feta, olive oil, fresh veg, dill and lemon are all plain home foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a saucepan, sieve, grater, bowl and knife, and the techniques are simple wilting, squeezing and mixing.

works.reason: 200g wilted spinach with 250g yoghurt and 100g feta makes a well-seasoned dip, with the salty feta replacing added salt, and three carrots, a cucumber and a bunch of radishes give plenty of dippers for four.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is believable for squeezing and chopping the spinach, grating garlic, zesting, chopping dill and cutting the veg into sticks, and a 2-minute wilt fits within 5 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A fresh spinach dip with radishes and cucumber suits a mid-May afternoon, and spinach is clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a beginner could follow, with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a proper snack of vegetables, yoghurt and cheese that a family would happily eat again.
